comment: Curated knowledge layer: high-value stock FFmpeg filters with what they're FOR and a worked example. Surfaced to the agent via list_creative_filters so composing looks is grounded instead of guessed. All filters verified present in stock FFmpeg 8.x.

filters.purpose: Per-channel tone curves — THE color-grading primitive (lift shadows, roll highlights, split-tone).
Push shadows/midtones/highlights toward a color independently (rs/gs/bs, rm/gm/bm, rh/gh/bh, each -1..1).
Remix RGB channels into each other — cross-process, sepia, channel-swap looks.
Basic brightness/contrast/saturation/gamma — the workhorse finishing pass.
Rotate hue / scale saturation; supports time expressions for animated color cycling.
Targeted hue/sat/intensity adjustment with per-color-range selection (like an HSL qualifier).
CMYK adjustments within named color ranges — 'make the reds more orange' style asks.

Apply a .cube 3D LUT — the universal Resolve/Premiere look-interchange format. Call list_luts for available files; use a raw node with the path single-quoted. Dial intensity below 100% via the split+blend pattern (see 'split + blend').
Film grain / analog noise; allf=t makes it temporal (live grain), +u uniform, +p patterned.
Gaussian blur — soft focus, glow bases, dreamy looks (combine with negative unsharp).
Sharpen (positive amount) or smooth-glow (negative amount).
Darken frame edges; angle controls strength (PI/5 strong, PI/7 subtle).
Shift R/G/B planes independently — chromatic aberration, glitch, 3D-anaglyph vibes.
Blend consecutive FRAMES — motion trails, echo/ghosting (all_mode + all_opacity).
Decaying frame buffer — light-trail / long-exposure streaks from bright areas.
Key out a color (green screen) to transparency; pair with overlay for compositing.
Merge two streams through a grayscale mask — region-selective grading (needs labeled multi-stream graph).
Intensity-dial ANY look: split the stream, grade one branch, blend back at N%. Works inline mid-chain.
Motion-interpolated frame rate conversion — smooth slow motion (SLOW to encode).
Ken Burns pan & zoom via expressions over time.
Mosaic/censor blocks — retro pixel-art or privacy masking.
Single-pass camera stabilization for mild shake.
Spatio-temporal denoise — clean up noisy footage BEFORE grading.
